messages:
maya: Heads-up — staging customers hitting duplicate token output on reconnects to the streaming API. Repro pretty reliably with a 1s blip.
sam: Can you paste repro steps and any logs?
maya: Steps:
1) open SSE to /v1/streams with `session_id` cookie
2) send prompt, stream starts
3) cause short network blip, client reconnects immediately using `Last-Event-ID`
4) server replays last chunk but also continues the previously in-flight generation -> duplicated tokens in client

Logs (gateway):
```
INGRESS 2026-03-10T14:12:03Z conn=abcd drop-header Last-Event-ID
PROXY  2026-03-10T14:12:03Z conn=abcd restart
UPSTREAM 2026-03-10T14:12:04Z id=evt-42 replay chunk
UPSTREAM 2026-03-10T14:12:04Z id=evt-42 resume generation -> new tokens
```

oliver: If the gateway drops `Last-Event-ID` we lose idempotency hints. Could be the proxy healthcheck dance. We probably create a new request id server-side which triggers a fresh generation while also replaying queued events.

toni: Also seeing quota double-charge for same session. Console shows two requests: original (failed) + reconnect (succeeded). Billing counts both.
maya: Exactly. The billing path treats reconnect as an independent request. We need dedupe at telemetry/usage side.
sam: Two problems then: (1) runtime re-emitting tokens on reconnect, (2) billing/telemetry double-count. Which do we fix first?

oliver: Short-term patch: honor `Last-Event-ID` at the gateway and forward it reliably. We can also attach `x-redwood-session-id` on proxy restart. That avoids generating a new run.

toni: For billing: add a server-side dedupe window keyed by (customer_id, session_id, last_event_id) — if we've already accounted tokens for those event IDs, mark duplicates as 0-charge. Easy-ish to implement in usage pipeline.
maya: Concern: per-event dedupe requires a lookup per event. If we use Redis it could be hot (high QPS). Might be expensive for large streams.

sam: Alternative: tag reconnects as "resumed" and then route usage accounting to the original request id. We already emit a `run_id` for each generation; if reconnect supplies `Last-Event-ID` we map to original `run_id` and continue accounting there. That requires persisting run_id -> session mapping for TTL of the call.

oliver: That seems better than per-event Redis. Persist run metadata at start: {run_id, session_id, last_event_id_seen, token_count} with TTL = max_stream_duration + 60s. On reconnect, lookup by (session_id, last_event_id) -> run_id. If found, attach run_id header `x-original-run` and mark server not to double-charge.

maya: We also need to fix Console UX: right now the Console shows failed request and a new succeeded one. Operators get confused. If we map reconnects to the original run_id, Console should show a single timeline and a "resumed" badge.
toni: Small UX ask: show a reconnect timeline event with delta tokens and an explicit "deduped" state. PMs like visible telemetry.

sam: Implementation plan proposal:
- gateway: forward `Last-Event-ID` and `session_id`  (PR: @oliver)  — hotfix (patch release)
- runtime: attach `run_id` persistence and resume header handling (PR: @maya) — next minor
- billing: accept `x-original-run` header to attribute tokens to original run (PR: @toni) — tie into usage pipeline
- console: join events by run_id and add "resumed" marker (PR: @sam)

deploy-bot: Scheduled window: staging hotfix deploy 2026-03-11 02:00 UTC, canary to prod 2026-03-12 04:00 UTC :rocket:

monitoring-bot: Alert rule created: `streaming.reconnect.duplicate_tokens` threshold 5/m in prod; paging to #eng-oncall if sustained >1m

oliver: One more thing — we need to consider Last-Event-ID semantics vs SSE `id` semantics. Some clients will send the last event id of the last chunk they successfully processed, which may be mid-token. Our runtime should only dedupe complete token events. Suggest using event-level ids at token boundaries.
maya: Agreed. We'll add fine-grained event ids: `evt-{seq}` that increment on token flush. Also update SDKs to buffer until token commit then ack.
toni: Can we retroactively patch existing logs so billing team can reconcile impacted customers?
sam: We'll run a reconciliation job to merge duplicate charges between 2026-03-01 and 2026-03-10 and credit affected accounts. Finance OK'ed the refresh if we get the dedupe fix in this week.

maya: I'll open the runtime PR with the `run_id` persist + resume header. Minimal change: store mapping in existing metadata table with TTL. If we hit scale issues we can switch to a sharded in-memory cache.

oliver: I'll work the gateway patch. Quick test matrix: normal stream, blip+reconnect, long tail reconnect ( > TTL ), replay scenario.

sam: Assign owners and call it out in the all-hands postmortem thread later. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

maya: FYI — adding a test harness that simulates flakey networks and asserts no duplicates + same billing. If anyone wants to add edge cases ping me.
